source_text.body:
Fill flight booking forms from an Excel sheet
A daily Comet user uploaded a spreadsheet and had Comet fill in flight booking forms for nine people, and also uses it for shopping and price comparison.
Done with
PC
Perplexity Comet
What they did
The author needed to enter full details for nine passengers on a flight booking portal: names, dates of birth and passport details. They uploaded an Excel sheet to Comet, Perplexity's agentic browser, and let it fill in the form while they dealt with the rest of the booking. The article gives no prompt or step-by-step detail.
How it went
Comet filled in the passenger details well, though the author calls it a slow process. The article gives no error counts or time figures.
Worth knowing
Passport and date-of-birth data goes to an AI with access to your accounts, and the article itself flags privacy concerns and higher resource use than Chrome.
Try it yourself
with
Perplexity Comet
Copy prompt
I'm attaching a spreadsheet with details for [number, e.g. 9] travelers: [columns, e.g. full name, date of birth, passport number, contact email]. Go to [airline or booking site] and fill in the booking form for the [route and dates] flight for each person using the sheet. Do not submit or pay for anything; pause before each submission and show me the filled-in details so I can confirm. You're done when every traveler's form is filled out and I've reviewed them.
Original source: https://www.makeuseof.com/comet-browser-features-better-than-chrome/
